components.label: Description
components.quote: FLUCELVAX (Influenza Vaccine) is a trivalent subunit influenza vaccine manufactured using cell derived candidate vaccine viruses (CVV) that are propagated in Madin Darby Canine Kidney (MDCK) cells, a continuous cell line.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Each dose of FLUCELVAX may contain residual amounts of MDCK cell protein (≤ 21.6 mcg), protein other than HA (≤ 225 mcg), MDCK cell DNA (≤ 10 ng), polysorbate 80 (≤ 1125 mcg), cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (≤ 13.5 mcg), and β-propiolactone (< 0.5 mcg), which are used in the manufacturing process.

allergens.quote: FLUCELVAX contains no egg protein or antibiotics.

allergens.quote: The tip caps and plungers of the pre-filled syringes and the multi-dose vial stopper are not made with natural rubber latex.

Each dose of FLUCELVAX may contain residual amounts of MDCK cell protein (≤ 21.6 mcg), protein other than HA (≤ 225 mcg), MDCK cell DNA (≤ 10 ng), polysorbate 80 (≤ 1125 mcg), cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (≤ 13.5 mcg), and β-propiolactone (< 0.5 mcg), which are used in the manufacturing process.
FLUCELVAX 5 mL multi-dose vials contain thimerosal, a mercury derivative, added as a preservative.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: Do not administer FLUCELVAX to anyone with a history of a severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) to any component of the vaccine [see Description (11)].

dismissed.egg: 全文掃描『egg』命中僅在14 CLINICAL STUDIES 段落，指臨床試驗對照組疫苗 AGRIFLU 為『egg-based trivalent influenza comparator』與『Egg derived antigen hemagglutination inhibition (HI) assay』檢測方法，均非本疫苗（FLUCELVAX）自身成分，本疫苗成分句已明確標示 status=無
